en: Illustrated scene of an Arab wedding procession in a Middle Eastern town. Several elaborately decorated camels carry riders in traditional dress, including a veiled figure likely representing the bride. Other men, women, and children in robes stand or sit nearby in front of low plastered buildings with wooden awnings. The style is vintage, with muted colors and a printed caption at the bottom left. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower right.
